subject: qbank.spec 'search hit opens the single question' fails on WebKit: pageerror for /api/cards/stats cut off by navigation
body: Local smoke (webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-phone-390): 'pageerror: /api/cards/stats?tz=UTC due to access control checks.' WebKit reports any fetch torn down by a navigation as a page error. What fixed the same thing for ink: the GET passes keepalive: true (no body, so the 64 KB limit does not matter) so the unload never cancels it (apps/web/src/ink/persist/transport.ts). Alternatively make the specs wait for it before navigating.
